definitions.mode_catalog: Fixed fitted modal carrier centers, not instantaneous pitch. Nominal harmonic indices label near-harmonic assignments, not independently verified physical harmonics. Nine subpoles can lie +/-0.6 Hz around each nominal center.
definitions.profile: Absolute complex modal envelope at contact age 40 ms, L2 normalized across this string modes. Ratio amplitude_over_fundamental_40ms uses the nominal h=1 mode.
definitions.energy_decay: Sum of squared modal envelope magnitudes at ages 0..1.5 s, divided by maximum on that age grid. Includes 4 ms attack and pole interference; not necessarily monotonic and not calibrated physical energy.
definitions.frames: Magnitudes of coherently summed model complex envelopes, including contact overlap and initial ringing, in raw fitted units before playback normalization; rows align frame_time_s and columns mode_ids. No mixed-recording spectrum included.
definitions.strength_v4: No shared scalar force exists. strength is null; amplitude_40ms_l2 is an unsigned response-magnitude proxy, not contact force.
definitions.strength_v5: Signed fitted real force scalar multiplying every component of the fixed string response; unitless and scale-normalized by fitter.
definitions.initial_state: Stored separately, never a tail contact. V4 uses attack/decay atoms with global activity mask; v5 uses tau=1.5s initial coefficients within each recording interval only.
definitions.scope: In-sample audio-constrained inverse model, not independent physical simulation, isolated original-string measurement, or evidence of actual dog motion.
